name: Palatino Arms Deadlock
description: Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower. The Deadlock variant features a grey camo pattern with yellow highlights.
